misconception: Treat the potential coefficient a² as the spatial variance parameter, equivalent to the Gaussian exp(-t²/(2a²)), instead of using the positive square-root frequency a; its squared amplitude has variance a²/2.
reason: This coefficient-versus-spatial-width confusion adds a genuine larger wrong value, removes the unique-length cue, and preserves the original numerical-rank pattern.
